Wilfred Wong has spent years investigating claims of satanic ritual abuse in Britain, work that has made him both a celebrated campaigner and a controversial figure. In this episode of Danny Jones's podcast, recorded when it was still called KONCRETE, Wong describes hunting the cults he believes abuse children in secret ceremonies.

Wong lays out his cases and methods, and the resistance he says he meets from police and media. Ritual abuse claims have a troubled history, including convictions later overturned and panics now widely regretted, which listeners should hold in mind. Wong's account is his own, preserved as he gives it. The episode documents a living branch of a very old fear, argued by a man who has staked his life on its truth.
